question_summary: Contractor requests approval to substitute ABS DWV piping in lieu of specified no-hub cast-iron soil piping (Section 22 13 16) prior to ordering material.
proposed_solution: Use ABS DWV alternate in lieu of no-hub cast-iron soil piping.
deadline_text: A response by the end of the day would let us keep the order on track.
routing_rationale: The request concerns a plumbing DWV piping material substitution and requires plumbing engineering review for code and performance compliance.
